payload.description: Duo boon, not a rotation. Merciful End requires both an Ares Doom boon (Curse of Agony or Curse of Pain on attack/special) and an Athena boon with Deflect (Divine Strike, Divine Flourish, or Divine Dash). When any attack with Deflect property is used, Doom effects trigger INSTANTLY — bypassing the normal 1.1-second delay. Grants +50 bonus damage per trigger (per source). Loop: apply Doom via Ares boon, then deflect via Athena boon to fire instant detonation.
